definitions.gloss: ostracism; being shunned by one's community
definitions.explanation: Originally the shunning of a household by the rest of a village for breaking its rules. Now used for any group cutting someone off socially.

examples.japanese: {村八分|むらはちぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}った→破る：02321_yaburu⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{村八分|むらはちぶ}になった。
examples.english: The family that broke the rules was shunned by the village.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{村八分|むらはちぶ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Because I spoke up to my boss, I'm being frozen out at work.

notes:
The common explanation: of the ten occasions when villagers helped each other, the shunned household was cut off from eight and helped only with the other two, a funeral and a fire.

- {村八分|むらはちぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to ostracize
